categories.title: Chart of accounts
categories.description: Expense categories, grouped as in the income statement. Adjust the names to your practice.
categories.deductibleHint: "Deductible" is the suggestion for the carnê-leão Livro-Caixa (individuals in Brazil). The tax authority accepts operating expenses needed for the work, such as rent, condo fees, water, power, phone, consumables, council fees and salaries with payroll taxes; property tax and bills of a home only in the share used for sessions. It doesn't accept equipment, depreciation or transportation. The INSS you pay as self-employed doesn't go in the Livro-Caixa, but it's deducted directly in the carnê-leão. For debatable categories (supervision, courses, software) we left "no": confirm with your accountant.

reports.title: Financial reports
reports.description: Cash flow, monthly result, where the money goes and the carnê-leão Livro-Caixa.
reports.cashflowDescription: Actual by payment date; forecast by the due date of what's still open. Future months in gray.
reports.dreDescription: Accrual basis: revenue by charge due date and expenses by the month they belong to. Cancelled bills are left out.
reports.byCategoryDescription: Expenses for the year on accrual basis: {total}.
reports.bySupplierDescription: The 15 with the most expenses this year.
reports.livroDescription: The Livro-Caixa is the record of income and expenses that lowers the tax of professionals working as individuals in Brazil. Here: income received and deductible expenses paid each month. The deduction is capped at the month's income; the rest carries over to the following months, only until December. It isn't the final carnê-leão base: remove income from clinics, insurers and companies (legal entities, already withheld) and deduct the INSS paid and dependents.
reports.livroEntriesDescription: Paid expenses marked as deductible. Interest and late fees are left out; discounts reduce the amount.
reports.livroEmpty: No deductible expenses paid this year.
reports.livroDisclaimer: Support for filling in the carnê-leão on e-CAC. Income considers the charges marked as paid in Salutti. Confirm with your accountant before filing and keep receipts for 5 years.
reports.livroLimited: In some month the deduction was capped by the income recorded in Salutti. If you also got paid outside it (cash, direct Pix), your real income is higher and so may be the deduction: check with your accountant.
